how_to_apply: Fill the application form printed with the advertisement (3 pages).
Paste a self-signed passport size coloured photograph on the form; do not staple it.
Attach self-certified copies of the documents listed on page 3 of the form.
Send the filled form by e-mail to [email protected] by 21 November 2026, 17:00 hrs.
Applications sent by any other medium or received after the due date will not be entertained.
Bring the hard copy of the form with self-certified copies of degrees and experience on the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KSSSCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KSSSCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Health Economist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KSSSCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 21 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years (as on the date of walk-in interview). Relaxation: Age relaxation will be given as per ICMR rules /UP Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 67,000 + HRA per month (consolidated emolument).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's in Health Economics/ /Public Health/Community Medicine/ Statistics with specialization in Healthcare Costing, Economic Evaluation, and 02 years of experience in the field of health economics.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentary proof of experience claimed is a must.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Personal interview/selection process for eligible candidates. Only eligible candidates will be invited for personal interview/selection process. Only successful candidates will be informed of the result by e-mail.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary on ad-hoc basis for one year, subject to renewal based on performance as assessed by the Principal Investigator. Recruitment is for the project only; the project employee will not be treated as an employee of KSSSCI and has no claim to a permanent position. Appointment subject to medical fitness certification by the Medical Board of the Institute/authorized medical board.
